businessProfile.productSummary: High-end technical outerwear and ski shells designed for professional ski patrollers and serious backcountry skiers.

reasons: High concentration of tech-adjacent urban professionals in US-West and US-Northeast who have the disposable income for $650+ outerwear and a high propensity for outdoor sports like skiing.
Balanced gender split (52% female, 47% male) aligns well with backcountry skiing demographics.
Audience values high-quality, sustainable, and functional apparel.
Audience is highly fitness-engaged and actively purchases activewear.
Strong presence in US-West, a key geographic region for backcountry skiing.
While heavily female-skewing (82%), it represents a highly relevant segment of affluent women looking for high-performance athletic apparel.

variants.headline: Engineered for the Backcountry: Patrol-Tested Technical Shells
variants.body: Built for elite performance. Our professional-grade technical shells are trusted by ski patrollers to withstand the harshest alpine environments. Featuring high-performance technical fabric designed for maximum mobility and complete storm protection during intense backcountry climbs.
variants.rationale: This copy directly appeals to the fitness enthusiast by highlighting athletic performance, mobility, technical fabrics, and the endorsement of professional ski patrollers.

variants.headline: An Investment in Mountain Protection: The Professional Ski Shell
variants.body: Crafted for ultimate durability and performance, our technical shells are built to endure season after season. Trusted by professional ski patrollers, this outerwear offers understated design and uncompromising protection on the mountain. A timeless piece engineered to last.
variants.rationale: This copy lands with the affluent classic by focusing on craftsmanship, longevity, understated aesthetics, and lasting value as a premium investment.

variants.headline: Optimize Alpine Performance: Technically Engineered Ski Shells
variants.body: Protect your body in extreme alpine conditions. Engineered with advanced technical fabrics, our shells are trusted by professional ski patrollers for reliable thermal and environmental regulation. Designed to optimize your safety and physical output during demanding backcountry ascents.
variants.rationale: This copy addresses the wellness optimizer by framing the outerwear as a tool for physical optimization, thermal regulation, and systematic safety in extreme conditions.

bidStrategy.rationale: Considered purchase at ~$700 AOV: bid to a target CPA of 20-35% of order value so first-order economics stay profitable

budget.rationale: $1500/publisher/month floor for statistically useful volume × 2 publishers × 1.5 luxury-tier multiplier
